_comment: Grow's worlds: each part of the app as its own place to grow. The order here is the order on Grow's home. A world is `live` once it has lessons; one that is not shows on the map as coming, so the road ahead is visible. `kind` says which screen a live world opens (GrowPanel.jsx SCREENS): `words` runs lessons through the quiz's own word list, `prayer` is the step map of what is said in prayer. Its colour is theme.json's `world` group, by id.

worlds.name: Words
worlds.idea: Every word you learn is a seed planted.

worlds.name: Prayer
worlds.idea: What you say in prayer, said right, step by step.

worlds.name: Quran
worlds.idea: Each ayah you fill in lights a star.

worlds.name: Hadith
worlds.idea: Each hadith you learn lights a lamp.

worlds.name: Sarf
worlds.idea: Build words from their roots and patterns.

worlds.name: Nahw
worlds.idea: Find who does what in a sentence.

_lesson: One lesson of the Words world. `new` is how many words never answered before it teaches, `size` how many words it asks in all; the rest are words due for review (the server's review timer decides which). With too little due it teaches more new words, up to `most-new`, so a first lesson is not five cards long and not twenty either. A word answered wrong comes back once at the end of the lesson. `bank` is which of the quiz's word sets it walks through, in that set's own order.
_stages: The Words world's stages: how many words of its set must be learnt (the server's 'known') to finish each one. The last should not pass the size of the set.
